written.headline: US Treasury proposes expanding investment curbs on Chinese AI and biotech firms
written.summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a proposal to broaden outbound investment restrictions on Chinese companies in AI, biotechnology and other advanced technologies, and to extend the program to Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Russia. The rule would require mandatory reporting for many transactions and could prohibit about 200 investment deals a year, with a public comment period ending Dec. 7.

written.headline: Block releases Dessa, a full‑duplex speech‑to‑speech model that runs locally
written.summary: Block unveiled Dessa, a voice model that can listen and speak simultaneously and runs on consumer‑grade GPUs such as a MacBook M4 Max. The model is trained solely on human conversation and aims to sound more natural than existing voice AIs.
